title.zh: 活跃通勤（台达电子国际（新加坡）私人有限公司在明地迷亚路所获得的豁免）命令 2026
title.en: Active Mobility (Delta Electronics Int’l (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. — Exemption for Bendemeer Road) Order 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 8 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Active Mobility (Delta Electronics Int’l (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. — Exemption for Bendemeer Road) Order 2026.
(2) This Order is in force for the period between 16 June 2026 and 31 July 2027 (both dates inclusive).

heading.en: Exemption for individual who initiates operation and movement of AIDEN delivery robot
Exemption for individual who takes manual control of AIDEN delivery robot on instruction of another individual
Exemption for individual who remotely monitors and takes manual control of AIDEN delivery robot
Exemption for individual who follows and takes manual control of AIDEN delivery robot

text.en:
7. The common conditions are —
(a)the AIDEN delivery robot is only operated for the purpose of carrying out a permitted purpose within the specified area;
(b)there is in force, at any time the AIDEN delivery robot is used in connection with a permitted purpose, a policy of insurance in relation to the AIDEN delivery robot insuring against any liability in respect of —
(i)the death of or bodily injury sustained by any person (whether or not including an individual exempt under paragraph 3, 4, 5 or 6); and
(ii)any property damage suffered by any person (whether or not including an individual exempt under paragraph 3, 4, 5 or 6),
caused by or arising out of the use of the AIDEN delivery robot; and
(c)the risk under the policy of insurance mentioned in sub‑paragraph (b) is assumed by an insurer who, at the time the policy is issued, is lawfully carrying on an insurance business in Singapore.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Specified area and specified footpaths
